title: Area formula for the blow-ups of an injective regular image (step 3)
statement:
Let P, n ∈ ℕ, g : ℝ^n → ℝ^P, B ⊆ ℝ^n a Borel set, z ∈ ℝ^n, s > 0 and f : ℝ^P → ℝ an arbitrary function. Assume g is differentiable at every a ∈ B, g is injective on B, and Dg(a) is injective for every a ∈ B. Notation:
- B_s := {b ∈ ℝ^n : z + sb ∈ B}.
- η_{w,s}(y) := s^{-1}(y − w) (SimonGMT blowUpMap).
- J(a) := √det(Dg(a)* ∘ Dg(a)), where Dg(a)* is the adjoint; this is Simon's Jacobian J_g, Ch. 2 (3.3).
Then ∫_{η_{g(z),s}(g(B))} f dH^n = ∫_{B_s} J(z + sb) · f(s^{-1}(g(z + sb) − g(z))) dL^n(b). Here H^n = μHE[n] on ℝ^P and L^n is Lebesgue measure on ℝ^n. Both sides are Bochner integrals, with value 0 for non-integrable integrands.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (g : Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)) (z : Euclid n) (s : ℝ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), MeasurableSet B → (∀ a ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ g a) → InjOn g B → (∀ a ∈ B, Injective (fderiv ℝ g a)) → 0 < s → ∫ y in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap (g z) s '' (g '' B), f y ∂μHE[n] = ∫ b in {b : Euclid n | z + s • b ∈ B}, Real.sqrt (((fderiv ℝ g (z + s • b)).adjoint ∘L fderiv ℝ g (z + s • b)).det) * f (s⁻¹ • (g (z + s • b) - g z))
